intro.zh: 涵蓋簡報、連接器、排程工作與 Skills：檢查你是否知道什麼要先交代、哪些權限要收緊、哪些決定要留給人。80 分通過；本測驗為課程自編練習，非 Anthropic 官方認證。
intro.en: Covers slides, connectors, scheduled tasks and Skills: do you know what to state up front, which permissions to tighten and which decisions stay with people? Pass at 80. A course-made practice quiz, not an official Anthropic certification.

q.zh: 社團要你 10 分鐘分享花蓮三日遊，請 Claude 做簡報前，最該先告訴它什麼？
q.en: You must give a 10-minute talk on a Hualien trip. What should you tell Claude before it builds slides?

opts.zh: 直接要求「做十頁，越多字越好」
opts.en: Just ask for ten text-heavy slides

opts.zh: 先指定每頁的字型與顏色
opts.en: Fonts and colours for every slide first

opts.zh: 聽眾、時間與聽完希望他們做什麼
opts.en: Audience, time and what you want them to do afterward

opts.zh: 先請它隨機挑選主題
opts.en: Let it pick a random topic

why.zh: 先定聽眾、時間與目的，再讓 Claude 列故事線，比直接要求頁數更不容易失焦。
why.en: Audience, time and goal come first; a storyline then keeps the deck focused better than a page count.

q.zh: 風場季度運維檢討簡報，交出前 Claude 提供的預演問答（如可利用率為何下降）該如何使用？
q.en: Before a wind-farm quarterly review, Claude drafts rehearsal questions such as why availability dropped. How should you use them?

opts.zh: 當作預演方向，答案用真實紀錄補上
opts.en: As rehearsal prompts; fill answers from real records

opts.zh: 直接當成正式答案報告
opts.en: Present them as the official answers

opts.zh: 省略資料核對，因為 Claude 已讀過簡報
opts.en: Skip checking since Claude read the deck

opts.zh: 改問 Claude 要不要停機
opts.en: Ask Claude to decide on shutdown

why.zh: Claude 給的是預演題與方向；數字要回到資料核對，停機與上鎖掛牌由人員確認。
why.en: Claude gives practice questions and directions; check numbers against data, and people confirm shutdown and lockout/tagout.

q.zh: 連接器對 Claude 的作用，下列哪一項描述最正確？
q.en: Which best describes what a connector does for Claude?

opts.zh: 讓 Claude 自動看到你電腦所有檔案
opts.en: It lets Claude see every file on your computer

opts.zh: 讓 Claude 不需要登入就能使用任何服務
opts.en: It lets Claude use any service without signing in

opts.zh: 只是把對話內容備份到雲端
opts.en: It only backs up your chats

opts.zh: 你授權後，Claude 才能到外部服務查資料或代辦
opts.en: After you authorize, Claude can look up data or act in an external service

why.zh: 連接器是你登入並授權後的橋，每個連接器各接一個服務，由你決定開不開。
why.en: A connector is a bridge you authorize by signing in; each connects one service and you decide whether it is on.

q.zh: 你想讓 Claude 查設備手冊與工單，但不想讓它隨意改動資料。連接器的權限可以怎麼設？
q.en: You want Claude to search manuals and work orders but not change data. How can you set connector permissions?

opts.zh: 全部設成一律允許，事後再檢查
opts.en: Set everything to Always allow and review later

opts.zh: 把寫入類工具設為「需要核准」或「封鎖」
opts.en: Set write tools to Needs approval or Blocked

opts.zh: 權限無法調整，只能整個刪掉
opts.en: Permissions cannot be adjusted, only removed

opts.zh: 改成每次把手冊貼進對話
opts.en: Paste the manual into every chat

why.zh: 每組工具可設「一律允許」、「需要核准」或「封鎖」；讀取與寫入可分開管理。
why.en: Each tool group can be Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked, so reading and writing can be managed separately.

q.zh: 下列哪一件事最適合交給排程工作？
q.en: Which task suits a scheduled task best?

opts.zh: 決定風機是否緊急停機
opts.en: Deciding whether to shut down a turbine

opts.zh: 對外承諾客戶交期
opts.en: Committing a delivery date to a client

opts.zh: 每個工作日早上整理天氣與行程提醒
opts.en: A weekday-morning weather and agenda reminder

opts.zh: 需要現場判斷的設備上鎖掛牌
opts.en: On-site lockout/tagout judgement

why.zh: 固定時間、格式固定的整理適合排程；高風險或需判斷的決定留給人。
why.en: Recurring, fixed-format summaries suit scheduling; high-risk or judgement calls stay with people.

q.zh: 產線每班的警報摘要排程跑完後，較妥當的做法是？
q.en: After a scheduled alarm summary for each shift runs, what is the sound practice?

opts.zh: 直接依摘要讓 PLC 自動停機
opts.en: Let the PLC stop the line from the summary

opts.zh: 不必看，因為每次都一樣
opts.en: Skip it because it is always the same

opts.zh: 改成每小時各跑十次提高準確
opts.en: Run it ten times an hour for accuracy

opts.zh: 到 Scheduled 頁面檢查成果，處置由人員決定
opts.en: Check the result on the Scheduled page; people decide the response

why.zh: 排程只負責整理；成果可打開檢查，也能修改、暫停或手動執行，決定由人。
why.en: Scheduling only prepares summaries; you can inspect, edit, pause or run it manually, and people decide.

q.zh: 每週都要重新交代的「家庭採買清單」做法，寫成 Skill 有什麼好處？
q.en: What is the benefit of turning your weekly grocery-list routine into a Skill?

opts.zh: 相關任務出現時 Claude 自動照做，不必每次貼說明
opts.en: Claude follows it automatically on related tasks, no re-pasting

opts.zh: Claude 從此不再需要你確認清單
opts.en: Claude no longer needs you to confirm the list

opts.zh: 清單會自動公開給所有使用者
opts.en: The list is published to all users

opts.zh: 可以取代所有提示詞
opts.en: It replaces every prompt

why.zh: Skill 是放進資料夾的工作說明書，省去重複交代；清單內容仍由你出門前確認。
why.en: A Skill is a work manual in a folder that saves repeating yourself; you still confirm the list.

q.zh: 要讓 Claude 在對的時候用上你的 8D 報告技能，SKILL.md 開頭的描述應如何寫？
q.en: For Claude to use your 8D-report Skill at the right time, how should the description at the top of SKILL.md be written?

opts.zh: 越簡短越好，只寫一個字
opts.en: As short as possible, a single word

opts.zh: 寫得具體，說明什麼情境該使用
opts.en: Specific, saying what situations should trigger it

opts.zh: 留空，讓 Claude 自己猜
opts.en: Leave it blank and let Claude guess

opts.zh: 把整份 8D 範本全貼進描述
opts.en: Paste the whole 8D template into it

why.zh: 平常只帶名稱與描述，Claude 靠描述判斷何時載入正文；描述越具體越容易被正確觸發。
why.en: Normally only the name and description are loaded; Claude uses them to decide when to load the body, so specific wording triggers better.
